title: Scandinavian Diverticulitis Trial
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether laparoscopic lavage changes the rate of severe complications in patients with acute perforated diverticulitis who traditionally are treated with primary resection.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* age over 18
* clinical suspicion of perforated diverticulitis with indication for urgent surgery
* CT scan with free air and findings suggesting diverticulitis
* patient tolerates general anaesthesia
* patients written consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* pregnancy
* bowel obstruction
